lines.text: This is the teacher view of Kiddy. Sign in with the daycare account your manager gave you, and the app opens on your own dashboard.
The dashboard is your morning start. It shows the children in your classrooms, who is checked in now, open consents, and the latest reports.
Children lists every child in the classrooms assigned to you. Search by name, filter by status, or open a child profile.
The daily report is the heart of the child profile. Pick the date, record the meal, mood, sleep, toilet, and a note, then save it for the family.
About shows the child's room, date of birth, allergies, and care notes, so you have the important facts before the day starts.
Family holds the parents and pickup contacts, with phone, email, and pickup permission. Your manager controls who can collect the child.
Media keeps the photos and videos you share with the family. Upload from your device, and parents see it in their app.
Documents shows the consent requests sent for this child, with the parent's answer and the date.
Schedules shows the child's weekly plan, so you know which days they attend and which activities are planned.
Learning history collects your observations and assessments for this child, in one timeline you can revisit.
Incidents shows every incident linked to this child, with what happened, who reported it, and the parent's acknowledgement.
Attendance is your classroom register. Choose the day, filter by room, search for a child, then check them in or out. The bus buttons show who is on the bus.
Send a consent request to one child or the whole classroom. The list shows who approved, who denied, and who has not answered yet.
The Incidents page lists reports for your classrooms. Open one to read the details and see whether the parent has acknowledged it.
The newsfeed is how you talk to families. Write a post, choose a child, a classroom, or all families, add a photo, and publish.
Messages is your private inbox. Start a thread with a parent or a classroom, attach a file, and keep every reply together.
Calendar shows the center's events and field trips for the month, with the media shared for each one.
Create an event from the Events page. Add the title, date, time, place, and the families who should see it.
Parent drive shares a file with one family or with all families. Upload it once, and it appears in the parent app.
Learning is where you record development. Choose a child, pick a curriculum area, write what you observed, and add it to their history.
Activities covers the fun part of the day. Create an activity with a time, a place, and an audience, and parents get the update.
Homework lets you assign a task to one child or the whole classroom, with a due date and clear instructions.
Your staff profile shows your role, your rooms, and your contact details. Your manager keeps the team list up to date.
Staff schedule shows your weekly shifts, so you always know when you are expected in your classroom.
Working hours shows the center opening times and the rooms you can access.
Notifications collects messages, reports, and activity. Open an item to jump straight to the child or the conversation.
In Account settings you can change your photo, your password, your app language, and your push notifications.
That is the teacher workspace: every child, every daily record, and every message home, in one place.
